mostWorthwhile.text: Adding mineral to the collagen framework was worthwhile because the comparison showed how collagen provides toughness while mineral helps resist compression.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding bone cells and then blood vessels was clear, but felt a little repetitive as two successive assembly steps.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the joint lining contributes fluid that helps the cartilage-covered surfaces glide; at first I mainly saw it as a lining.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The pictures and goals explained where the pieces belonged, although the bone-cell names were unfamiliar until the lineage picture explained them.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing how the capsule, fluid and ligaments work together made me curious about how muscles will move the joint.
